identity.name: Cynthia Bar and Bistro
identity.notes: The live official site advertises current Summer dinner, brunch, and happy-hour menus and active reservations. The restaurant-linked Resy venue matches the name, 502 H Street NE address, phone, and official domain. 'Closed on Uber Eats' is a delivery-platform status, not evidence the restaurant is closed.

sources.title: Cynthia official homepage
sources.excerpt: Official site lists 502 H Street NE, Washington, DC 20002, current hours, phone, Resy booking, and the new Summer menus.

sources.title: Cynthia official menu index
sources.excerpt: Official menu page links current Happy Hour, Brunch, and Dinner & Drinks PDFs and warns that menus may change without notice.

sources.title: Cynthia Summer Dinner & Drinks menu
sources.excerpt: Eight-page official PDF; all current food and nonalcoholic sections were visually reviewed. Alcohol-only cocktails, wine, beer/cider, and spirits were excluded.

sources.title: Cynthia Summer Brunch menu
sources.excerpt: Two-page official PDF; all brunch mains, sides, and nonalcoholic beverages were visually reviewed. Alcohol-only brunch drinks were excluded.

sources.title: Cynthia Summer Happy Hour menu
sources.excerpt: Two-page official PDF; all happy-hour food was visually reviewed. Alcohol-only happy-hour drinks were excluded.

sources.title: Restaurant-linked Resy venue
sources.excerpt: Current Resy venue matches Cynthia Bar and Bistro at 502 H Street NE and shows bookable dinner times plus a link back to the official site/menu.

proposedChanges: Replace the under-extracted 24-row baseline with the 42-product current food and nonalcoholic catalog from the three official Summer PDFs.
Collapse repeated service-period presentations while retaining each official source and presentation label.
Remove seven parser-generated ingredient fragments as artifacts and preserve only direct restaurant-issued allergen positives.
Record the gluten-free cross-contamination warning at restaurant level without applying it to unrelated products; recompute Ingredient Intelligence after canonical catalog repair.

findings.summary: Seven frozen rows are ingredient-description fragments rather than orderable products.
Current official PDFs contain 51 in-scope service-period listings consolidated to 42 unique products.
No official allergen matrix was found; explicit menu ingredients and the gluten-free cross-contact warning are preserved without unsupported negatives.
